+
 
 class TestBoxTransform(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_sparse_3d_mask_preserves_foreground_labels_cpu(self):
+        mask = np.full((2, 2, 2, 2), -1, dtype=np.int16)
+        for channel, label in enumerate((0, 7)):
+            for point in ((0, 1, 0), (1, 0, 1)):
+                mask[(channel,) + point] = label
+        for backend in ("numpy", "torch"):
+            for custom_dtype in (False, True):
+                with self.subTest(backend=backend, custom_dtype=custom_dtype):
+                    value = mask.copy() if backend == "numpy" else torch.from_numpy(mask.copy())
+                    kwargs = dict(box_dtype=torch.float64, label_dtype=torch.int32) if custom_dtype else {}
+                    boxes, labels = convert_mask_to_box(value, **kwargs)
+                    self.assertIs(type(boxes), type(value))
+                    self.assertIs(type(labels), type(value))
+                    if backend == "torch":
+                        self.assertEqual(value.device.type, "cpu")
+                        self.assertEqual(boxes.device, value.device)
+                        self.assertEqual(labels.device, value.device)
+                        self.assertEqual(boxes.dtype, torch.float64 if custom_dtype else torch.float32)
+                        self.assertEqual(labels.dtype, torch.int32 if custom_dtype else torch.int64)
+                        boxes_np, labels_np = boxes.cpu().numpy(), labels.cpu().numpy()
+                    else:
+                        self.assertEqual(boxes.dtype, np.dtype("float64" if custom_dtype else "float32"))
+                        self.assertEqual(labels.dtype, np.dtype("int32" if custom_dtype else "int64"))
+                        boxes_np, labels_np = boxes, labels
+                    self.assertEqual(boxes_np.tolist(), [[0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 2.0, 2.0]] * 2)
+                    self.assertEqual(labels_np.tolist(), [0, 7])
+
+    @parameterized.expand(TESTS_2D_mask)
+    def test_value_2d_mask(self, mask, expected_box_label):
+        box_label = convert_mask_to_box(mask)
+        assert_allclose(box_label[0], expected_box_label[0], type_test=True, device_test=True, atol=1e-3)
+        assert_allclose(box_label[1], expected_box_label[1], type_test=True, device_test=True, atol=1e-3)
+
     @parameterized.expand(TESTS_2D)
     def test_value_2d(self, data, expected_mask):
         test_dtype = [torch.float32, torch.float16]
